title: Minimum Number of Visited Cells in a Grid
problemStatement: You are given an m × n grid of non-negative integers. Starting from the top-left cell, you may move: Right by at most grid[i][j] cells. Down by at most grid[i][j] cells. Return the minimum number of visited cells needed to reach the bottom-right cell. If the destination cannot be reached, return -1.
input: Integers m and n Grid of integers.
